headnotes.la: … salutaris nostri tempora processum est; ipseque Jhesus Christus humile non dedignatus hospicium, multum pietatis opera monstravit. In eodem profecto, cum nullius rei possessor existeret, dicente illo
headnotes.en: …mes of our Savior; and Jesus Christ himself, not disdaining the humble lodging, showed there many works of piety. Indeed, in that very place — since he was the possessor of nothing, as he himself says

headnotes.la: …bat multum quid faceret de tali re: et postquam satis cogitavit, obreptus fuit a sompno, et tunc angelus cepit ejus spiritum, et eundem portavit super montem Calvarii. Cui Rex regum apparuit, et dixit
headnotes.en: …h a matter; and after he had pondered enough, he was overtaken by sleep, and then an angel took his spirit and carried it up onto the mount of Calvary. There the King of kings appeared to him and said

headnotes.la: Eadem nocte, ipse manifestavit se sancto presbytero Melchiar, et dixit eidem
headnotes.en: That same night he made himself manifest to the holy priest Melchiar, and said to him

headnotes.la: …quod auscultare debent omnes in Deum credentes. Dominus noster Jhesus Christus apparuit Zachariae prophetae una die, quando faciebat sacrificium Deo, et in illa hora Filius Dei apparuit sibi, et dixit
headnotes.en: …ho believe in God ought to hear. Our Lord Jesus Christ appeared to Zacharias the prophet on a certain day, when he was making sacrifice to God; and in that hour the Son of God appeared to him and said

headnotes.la: …est, et omnes qui supererant fuerunt perditi, excepto Juliano Romano, qui per Filium Dei ad terram fuit exportatus benigniter. Et quando Julianus vidit infortunium quod evenerat, interrogavit Dominum,
headnotes.en: …ip was broken, and all who were left aboard were lost, except Julian the Roman, who was carried to land by the Son of God kindly. And when Julian saw the disaster which had happened, he asked the Lord

headnotes.la: Et Dominus noster respondit et dixit
headnotes.en: And our Lord answered and said

headnotes.la: …postolis faciebat salutem animarum. Deus qui fecit magna bona huic domui, quod ipsemet voluit se ostendere eis, extendit manus suas supra suos apostolos et pauperes mansionis praedictae; et tunc dixit
headnotes.en: …God, who did great good things to this house, in that he himself willed to show himself to them, stretched out his hands over his apostles and over the poor of the aforesaid dwelling; and then he said

headnotes.la: Notum facimus quod ista est mansio in qua Dominus noster dixit illi sapienti homini
headnotes.en: We make it known that this is the dwelling in which our Lord said to that wise man

headnotes.la: …er Jesus Christus fuit crucifixus. In ista sancta domo, venit virgo Maria et sanctus Johannes evangelista ad Dominum nostrum, quando ipse erat in cruce pro nobis peccatoribus, et dixit sancto Johanni,
headnotes.en: …ws, when our Lord Jesus Christ had been crucified. Into this holy house the Virgin Mary and St. John the Evangelist came to our Lord, when he was upon the cross for us sinners, and he said to St. John
And afterwards he said to his mother

headnotes.la: Adhuc est ista domus Hospitalis, in qua venit Jhesus in octavo die suae resurrectionis, portis clausis, et intravit in medio suorum discipulorum, et dixit eis
headnotes.en: This, further, is that house of the Hospital into which Jesus came on the eighth day of his resurrection, the doors being shut, and entered into the midst of his disciples, and said to them

headnotes.la: Et ostendit eis manus et pectus, sed Thomas non erat cum illis, quando Jesus venit. Et discipuli venerunt ad sanctum Thomam, et dixerunt ei
headnotes.en: And he showed them his hands and his breast; but Thomas was not with them when Jesus came. And the disciples came to St. Thomas and said to him

headnotes.la: Prope istos octo dies, sicut sanctus Johannes evangelista testatur, quando discipuli erant in ista sancta domo, et sanctus Thomas cum eis, venit Jhesus, clausis januis, et dixit
headnotes.en: Near these eight days, as St. John the Evangelist testifies, when the disciples were in this holy house, and St. Thomas with them, Jesus came, the doors being shut, and said

headnotes.la: Et in illa sancta domo recognovit sanctus Thomas suum Creatorem. Cui Dominus noster dixit
headnotes.en: And in that holy house St. Thomas acknowledged his Creator. To whom our Lord said
